dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Color ROLES. Components and product UI bind to a role, never to a palette tone or a literal. Roles come in pairs that are contrast-checked together: draw `on-x` content on `x`, and `on-x-container` on `x-container`. Surfaces step from surface-container-lowest to -highest to separate regions without borders.
rules: Choose a role by MEANING (error, success, warning, info, link, focus-ring, outline…), not by the color you expect it to have — a design system may give it any color.

A product-specific meaning (brand, correct/incorrect, a category) is a declared palette in the layer's "palettes" with "roles": "intent": it yields x, on-x, x-container, on-x-container. Do not reuse error/success for it and do not add tokens.
Never hardcode hex values in a product using Tanrei; they will not follow the scheme, the contrast level or the design system.
